result: Matrices, five radio controls, operations and full worked solutions readable without clipping or TeX errors. Relevant pair flips C1 coefficient -2 to +2 and B/solution; irrelevant pair preserves -2,+3 while updating off-target values; pivot pair changes labels/B/explanation with unchanged A. UI permutes answer order; option-frequency probe is order invariant. Preview shows answers after selection, not an unsubmitted learner cue.
